zh.title: 諾斯洛普格拉曼YFQ-48A原型機排定8月首飛 競逐美空軍CCA計畫
zh.summary: 諾斯洛普格拉曼YFQ-48A預計8月首飛，競逐美國空軍第二階段CCA計畫。
body: 諾斯洛普格拉曼（Northrop Grumman）開發的 YFQ-48A Talon Blue 無人機預計於 2026 年 8 月進行首飛。該機被視為美國空軍「協同戰鬥飛機」（CCA）第二階段計畫的競逐機型之一。
YFQ-48 於 2025 年 12 月公開，美國空軍隨後賦予其 YFQ-48A 代碼，並於 2026 年 2 月命名為 Talon Blue。該機設計較第一階段方案減重 1,000 磅，零件減少約 50%，製造速度提升 30%，採用 V 型尾翼與梯形進氣道。
YFQ-48 原型機採用普惠（Pratt & Whitney）PW500 系列發動機，機長與翼展估計為 10 至 12.5 公尺。美空軍於 2024 年選定通用原子與 Anduril 執行第一階段計畫，目標於 2029 年前後快速部署。

en.title: Northrop Grumman's YFQ-48A Talon Blue Scheduled for August First Flight
en.summary: Northrop Grumman plans the August 2026 first flight for its YFQ-48A Talon Blue CCA contender.
body: Northrop Grumman's YFQ-48A Talon Blue autonomous uncrewed aircraft is scheduled for its first flight in August 2026. The aircraft is widely regarded as a major contender for Increment 2 of the US Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) programme.

First unveiled in December 2025, the YFQ-48 received its official Air Force designation YFQ-48A the same month and was named Talon Blue in February 2026. Northrop Grumman stated that the aircraft is 1,000 pounds lighter, requires around 50% fewer parts, and is 30% faster to build than its Increment 1 proposal, featuring a V-tail and a dorsal trapezoid inlet.

Powered by a Pratt & Whitney PW500-family turbofan engine, the prototype has an estimated length and wingspan between 10 and 12.5 metres. The Air Force previously selected General Atomics' FQ-42 and Anduril's FQ-44 for Increment 1 in 2024, aiming to field initial CCA capabilities around 2029.
